<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="list"><item xmlns="">1</item><item xmlns="">2</item></data></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <assign location="$list/item[0]" expr="5"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" cond="$list/item[0] = 1" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the predicate `[0]` selects no node: XPath positions start at 1
notes: a numeric predicate `[n]` keeps only the node at position `n`, and XPath counts positions from 1, so no node is at position 0; assigning to a location that selects no node raises `error.execution`
diagnostics.help: XPath positions start at 1: select the first node with `[1]` (and the last with `[last()]`)
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
